$comment: Where the vendored catalog.json came from, and — when it leads the published engine — why that is allowed. `sync-catalog.mjs --check` enforces every claim in this file, in both directions: an unexplained difference fails, and so does an `aheadOfPublished` marker that the publish has since caught up with.
why: IN SYNC as of introspect-wasm@0.71.7 (core@ad571c7, tag v0.71.7): the core parity campaign's first release. Its catalog change is additive: the fill, stroke and content transparency targets' opacity and blend mode, a group's isolate and knockout, and the drop shadow's blend mode, spread, noise, knocked-out and global-light flag (core ADR 135); the document's global light as doc schema rows; each typed schema row's IDML mapping. No protocol change (71). Prior: in sync as of introspect-wasm@0.71.2 (core@7cad959).
